derivedNote: From a Google account, Fitbit's own number. From Health Connect, which doesn't carry it, Pulse computes it from your band's heart rate and steps, following Fitbit's rules as closely as Health Connect allows, so Fitbit's number may differ a little.

info.stress: How hard your body is working, from 0 to 100, from heart rate against your usual range and HRV at night. Workouts are left out.
info.hoursOfSleep: Time asleep during your main sleep session, excluding awake periods.
info.stressMonitor: How hard your body is working, from 0 to 100, from heart rate against your last 30 days and HRV at night. Workouts are left out.
info.healthMonitor: Your nightly vital signs against your last 30 nights. Unusual readings are signals to watch, not diagnoses.
info.healthspan: Pulse Age turns nine sleep, activity and fitness factors from the 28 days ending each Sunday into years older or younger than your age.
info.fitness: Your estimated aerobic fitness and training load, based on the measurements available from Health Connect.
info.heartRate: Heartbeats per minute recorded throughout the day. Gaps mean no reading was available.
info.heartRateVariability: Variation in time between heartbeats during sleep, in milliseconds. Compare it with your own usual range.
info.restingHeartRate: Your heart rate at rest. Recovery uses your average heart rate while asleep.
info.respiratoryRate: Breaths per minute during sleep, measured by your Fitbit.
info.bloodOxygen: Estimated oxygen saturation during sleep, measured by your Fitbit. Compare changes with your usual readings.
info.skinTemperature: Nightly temperature difference from your personal baseline, not your absolute body temperature.
info.sleepPerformance: How your sleep met tonight's need: time asleep, deep and REM sleep, heart-rate dip, efficiency and how rarely you woke.
info.recovery: Your readiness for the day, from last night's HRV, resting heart rate and Sleep Performance against your last 60 days.
info.strain: The load of your day as a percent, 0 to 100 on most days. Workouts and everyday activity both contribute.
info.calories: Estimated energy burned for the day or activity shown.
info.steps: Steps counted through the day. Today's count builds as new activity syncs.
info.weight: Your latest weight from a connected scale or a manual log.
info.bodyFat: Body fat percentage from a smart scale or a manual log.
info.distance: Distance covered during the day or activity shown.
info.floors: Floors climbed, counted from changes in altitude while walking.
info.elevationGain: Total height gained during the day.
info.activeMinutes: Minutes recorded as moderate or vigorous physical activity.
info.lightActivity: Minutes of light physical activity recorded through the day.
info.activeZoneMinutes: Activity minutes weighted by intensity. Higher-intensity minutes can count more than once.
info.activeCalories: Energy burned through movement, excluding resting energy.
info.sedentaryTime: Minutes recorded as sedentary during the day.
info.averageHeartRate: Average of the heart rate readings during the day or activity shown.
info.water: Water logged for the day. This reflects entries, not measured hydration.
info.caloriesEaten: Energy from food logged for the day. Missing entries make the total incomplete.
info.protein: Protein in the food logged for the day, in grams.
info.carbohydrates: Carbohydrates in the food logged for the day, in grams.
info.fat: Fat in the food logged for the day, in grams.
info.bloodGlucose: Your latest blood glucose reading from a connected meter or a manual log.
info.coreTemperature: Logged body temperature readings in degrees Celsius.
info.swimStrokes: Total swim strokes recorded in the day's activities.
info.recoveryTrend: Daily recovery scores over the selected period. Missing scores remain gaps.
info.whatShapedIt: The overnight measurements that contributed to this day's recovery, compared with your baseline.
info.tomorrowsForecast: An estimate based on your recent recovery and today's strain. Your next overnight measurements can change it.
info.timeInZones: Recorded minutes grouped by heart rate zone. Higher zones represent greater cardiovascular effort.
info.activities: Activities imported from your connected source for the selected day.
info.lastNightsSleep: Your main sleep session compared with your previous 30 days.
info.hoursVsNeeded: Sleep obtained compared with your sleep need: a 7.5-hour goal plus extra for strain and sleep debt.
info.sleepConsistency: How closely the times you are asleep agree across the last 7 days.
info.restorativeSleep: Time spent in deep and REM sleep, the stages grouped here as restorative sleep.
info.sleepEfficiency: Time asleep as a percentage of the main sleep session's duration.
info.sleepDebt: Your sleep shortfall over the last 7 days, recent nights counting most. A quarter of it adds to your sleep need.
info.restorativeSleepPct: The share of your time asleep spent in deep and REM sleep.
info.restorativeSleepHours: Time spent in deep and REM sleep, the stages grouped here as restorative sleep.
info.dayStrain: The load of your day as a percent, 0 to 100 on most days. Workouts and everyday activity both contribute.
info.hrZones13Weekly: Time in heart-rate zones 1 to 3 over the last 7 days, compared with your usual 7-day total.
info.hrZones45Weekly: Time in heart-rate zones 4 and 5 over the last 7 days, compared with your usual 7-day total.
info.hrZonesAllWeekly: Time in all heart-rate zones over the last 7 days, compared with your usual 7-day total.
info.strengthActivityTimeWeekly: Time in strength workouts over the last 7 days, compared with your usual 7-day total.
info.vo2Max: Your estimated aerobic fitness, in millilitres of oxygen per kilogram per minute.
info.leanBodyMass: Your weight minus body fat, from your latest weight and body fat readings.
info.paceOfAging: Your Pulse Age divided by your age: below 1.0x your body behaves younger than your years.
info.pulseAgeHistory: Changes in your estimated Pulse Age over time. This is a model estimate, not a clinical measurement.
info.percentile: How your estimated aerobic fitness compares with the reference population for your profile.
info.vo2MaxTrend: Estimated aerobic capacity over time. It reflects the VO2 max measurements available from your source.
info.trainingLoad: Recent training effort compared with your longer-term load, showing how quickly workload is changing.
info.fitnessFatigueAndForm: Fitness reflects longer-term load, fatigue reflects recent load, and form is the balance between them.
info.recoveryBreakdown: Number of days in each recovery range during the report period.
info.averages: Averages use days with recorded values. Missing days are excluded rather than counted as zero.
info.trainingBalance: How strain and recovery lined up during the report period.
info.topJournalEffects: Associations between logged habits and your scores. These comparisons do not prove a habit caused a change.
info.bestAndWorstDay: The highest and lowest recovery days with available scores in this period.
info.history: Recorded values over the selected range. Gaps mean data was unavailable, not zero.
info.byWeekday: Average recorded values grouped by weekday across the available period.
info.minutesByIntensity: Activity time split into the intensity levels reported by your source.
info.workouts: Recorded workouts contributing to this day's activity.
info.loggedEntries: Individual entries available for the selected day. Daily totals depend on what was logged.
info.eatenVsBurned: Logged food energy compared with estimated energy burned. Missing food entries can make intake look low.
info.macros: Protein, carbohydrates and fat from the day's logged food.
info.readings: Individual measurements available on or before the selected day.
info.unusualDays: Recorded values outside your recent personal range. An unusual value is not a diagnosis.
info.movementByHour: Hourly steps show when movement was recorded. A gap does not prove you were sedentary.
info.stepsByHour: Steps recorded in each hour of the selected day.
info.thisWeek: Recorded activity for the week containing the selected day. Missing days remain incomplete.
info.last7Days: Summary of recorded values in the last 7 days, compared with the 7 days before.
info.last30Days: Summary of recorded values in the last 30 days, compared with the 30 days before.
info.last6Months: Summary of recorded values in the last 6 months, compared with the 6 months before.
info.last12Months: Summary of recorded values in the last year, compared with the year before.
